raw_text: India just signed a 10-year Chabahar port deal with Iran. Interesting to see how Washington responds given the sanctions framework. Iranian media is spinning this hard as proof that sanctions don't work. The strategic logic for India is clear - they need Central Asia access without going through Pakistan. But framing this as anti-US is a stretch since State Department has historically given waivers for Chabahar specifically.
